evidence.detail: LoadoutsPanel creates this listener exclusively for the exact 'No, Nevermind.' button in the delete-active-loadout confirmation JFrame.
actionPerformed only hides and disposes that JFrame and performs no LoadoutManager mutation.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 cancel action for the active-loadout delete confirmation dialog.

evidence.detail: LoadoutsPanel creates this ActionListener for the affirmative button in its delete-active-loadout confirmation JFrame.
actionPerformed calls LoadoutManager.d(folderName, loadoutName) using the active folder name and active LoadoutDefinition name, then hides and disposes the confirmation frame.
The class owns only the panel, folder name, selected LoadoutDefinition and confirmation frame required by that delete operation.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 affirmative delete action for the active loadout confirmation dialog.
